Fixture: every indented line below has to be refused by the rule
no-suite-source-clone-in-workflows in .github/invariants.txt.

The lines are workflow steps rather than a whole workflow, because the rule is a
pattern over the text of a file in .github/workflows/ and not a reading of the
YAML. This file sits outside that directory, so it is never scanned as part of
the tree and GitHub never tries to run it.

    - run: git clone https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD.git
    - run: git clone --depth 1 --branch 1.1.3 git@github.com:FreeCAD/FreeCAD.git
          repository: FreeCAD/FreeCAD
    - run: git submodule add https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD vendor/suite

Three shapes and one of them is not a git command at all. The third line is the
input that makes the checkout action fetch somebody else's tree instead of this
one, and it is the spelling somebody reaches for who has never typed the git
command by hand. A rule written against the command alone passes it.

The fourth line is the shape that looks like a reference rather than a copy. A
submodule is a copy of the source tree held by pointer, and #4's rule is about
what this repository carries rather than about how it carries it.

Every other line in this file is prose and the rule has to match none of it,
which the run asserts by comparing the line numbers that matched against the
line numbers that are indented.
